summary: Rockfall and avalanche near the Dreamweaver Couloir on Mt. Meeker caught three climbers: one killed, one severely injured (hoisted by helicopter), one minorly injured.
location: Dreamweaver Couloir, Mt. Meeker (13,916 ft), Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: RMNP Search and Rescue; Colorado National Guard (Buckley AFB); Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Flight for Life; Med Evac; Front Range Rescue Dogs
notes: Slide at ~9am Sunday witnessed by other climbers; injured male hoisted by National Guard helicopter at 2pm to Medical Center of the Rockies; deceased male located ~5:15pm via RECCO/probe; female flown out with minor injuries.
